pages.title: Roblox Noob Waving on a Spawn Pad Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Roblox Noob waving from a round spawn pad, with a smiling face, raised blocky arm, and clouds above the game landscape. The plain torso and legs provide broad coloring areas, while the pad's concentric rings and simple background platforms add a few separate sections to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Roblox Bacon Hair Holding a Sword in a Battle Arena Coloring Page
pages.description: Roblox Bacon Hair holds a raised sword in a battle arena on this printable coloring page, wearing an open jacket beneath his layered, center-parted hair. Curved rows of arena seating, arched openings, and two flags frame the avatar. This coloring sheet combines large clothing sections with narrower hair strands and the sword's pointed blade.

pages.title: Roblox Guest Wearing an R Cap at a Game Entrance Coloring Page
pages.description: A waving Roblox Guest wears an R cap at a game entrance in this printable coloring page, standing beneath a large tilted square Roblox emblem. The gateway's tall pillars surround a smiling avatar with a plain shirt and blocky boots. Broad spaces dominate this coloring sheet, with smaller sections in the cap's letter and the entrance details.

pages.title: Roblox Builderman Holding a Blueprint at a Construction Site Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Roblox Builderman holding an unrolled blueprint at a construction site, with a hard hat, work vest, and pocketed pants. A crane lifts a beam behind the building framework, while stacked boards sit nearby. The coloring sheet pairs wide clothing areas with the blueprint's room outlines and the crane's triangular supports.

pages.title: Roblox Avatar Wearing a Dominus Hood Outside a Castle Coloring Page
pages.description: A Roblox avatar wears a Dominus hood outside a castle in this printable coloring page, with featherlike side ornaments, round clasps, and a ragged cape. Flag-topped towers and an arched entrance rise behind the figure. The coloring sheet offers broad hood and body sections alongside smaller feather shapes, battlements, and curved path stones.

pages.title: Roblox Robot Avatar Guarding a Futuristic Base Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts a Roblox robot avatar guarding a futuristic base, holding a large blaster across segmented armor beneath a helmet with tall antennae. The base has an angular doorway, steps, and watchtowers in the background. Armor plates, knee panels, and narrow weapon details give this coloring sheet many distinct geometric spaces.

pages.title: Roblox Ninja Holding a Katana Outside a Dojo Coloring Page
pages.description: A Roblox ninja holds a katana outside a dojo on this printable coloring page, wearing a face covering, tied headband, and wrap-style outfit with a sash. The blade cuts diagonally across the scene in front of steps and gridded doors. This coloring sheet includes broad outfit panels, narrow arm wraps, leafy trees, and scattered courtyard stones.

pages.title: Roblox Knight Carrying a Sword and Shield at Castle Gates Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Roblox knight carrying a sword and lion-emblem shield at castle gates, wearing plated armor and a helmet with a sweeping plume. Crown banners hang from the towers beside the raised portcullis. The coloring sheet has broad shield and armor sections, with smaller spaces in the lion's mane, helmet slots, and surrounding stonework.

pages.title: Roblox Samurai Drawing a Katana Beside a Bamboo Grove Coloring Page
pages.description: A Roblox samurai draws a katana beside a bamboo grove in this printable coloring page, gripping the patterned hilt while holding its sheath at his waist. Spiky hair, layered robe edges, and a knotted belt define the avatar. Tall bamboo stems, narrow leaves, rocks, and grass add smaller background spaces to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Roblox Zombie Walking Through an Abandoned Street Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page follows a Roblox zombie walking through an abandoned street, with outstretched arms, drooping eyes, torn clothing, and patches across its face. Boarded windows, broken walls, and scattered rubble surround the blocky figure. The coloring sheet mixes large clothing panels with irregular tears, cracked pavement, and small exposed rib details.

pages.title: Roblox Skeleton Avatar Standing Outside a Haunted House Coloring Page
pages.description: A Roblox skeleton avatar stands outside a haunted house in this printable coloring page, displaying a broad toothy skull, outlined ribs, and bones across its blocky limbs. A large moon, bare trees, and pointed windows frame the figure. Repeated bone shapes and the house's porch details give this coloring sheet smaller sections around the broad body panels.

pages.title: Roblox Headless Horseman Holding a Jack-o-lantern at a Mansion Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Roblox Headless Horseman holding a jack-o-lantern at a mansion, dressed in a high-collared coat, buttoned vest, ruffled cravat, and boots. The empty neck opening sits above an oval brooch, while the pumpkin has slanted eyes and a zigzag mouth. Gates, shrubs, and a stone path complete the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Roblox Dj Wearing Headphones at a Music Booth Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Roblox DJ wearing headphones at a music booth, with one hand on a turntable and the other against an earcup. Two tall speakers flank the avatar's hoodie and spiky hair. The coloring sheet includes broad clothing panels, circular speaker cones, and small mixer sliders, buttons, and knobs across the tabletop.

pages.title: Roblox Football Player Kicking a Soccer Ball on a Field Coloring Page
pages.description: A Roblox football player kicks a soccer ball across a grassy field in this printable coloring page, wearing a striped-shoulder jersey, shorts, and studded cleats. The raised foot shows its sole beside the ball's polygon panels, with a goal net behind the avatar. This coloring sheet combines open uniform sections with finer net squares and scattered grass tufts.

pages.title: Roblox Skateboarder Riding a Ramp at a Skatepark Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Roblox skateboarder riding a curved skatepark ramp, balancing with bent knees and spread arms beneath a backward baseball cap. A hoodie, chunky sneakers, and layered hair give the avatar distinct sections to color. The coloring sheet also includes the board's small wheels and trucks, plus long ramp edges and background railings.

pages.title: Roblox Police Officer Standing Beside a Patrol Car Coloring Page
pages.description: A Roblox police officer stands beside a patrol car in this printable coloring page, wearing a peaked badge cap, tie, shoulder radio, and loaded utility belt. The car has a roof light bar, front push bar, and large wheels. Broad uniform and vehicle panels share this coloring sheet with smaller pocket flaps, badges, grille openings, and radio details.

pages.title: Roblox Christmas Elf Carrying Presents Beside a Christmas Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts a Roblox Christmas elf carrying two wrapped presents beside a Christmas tree, wearing a pointed hat, striped stockings, and curled shoes. The elf's jagged collar and pointed ears sit beside bow-topped gifts and round tree ornaments. This coloring sheet offers broad box faces with smaller ribbon bands, baubles, and a large star topper.

pages.title: Roblox Halloween Witch Holding a Broom Beside Pumpkins Coloring Page
pages.description: A Roblox Halloween witch holds a broom beside carved pumpkins in this printable coloring page, wearing a wide pointed hat decorated with a bow and pumpkin. Long wavy hair frames a lace-up bodice, star necklace, and jagged skirt. The coloring sheet adds narrow broom bristles, a cratered moon, a bare tree, and several jack-o-lantern faces around the avatar.

pages.title: Roblox Noob Celebrating a Birthday with a Cake and Balloons Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Roblox Noob celebrating a birthday with cake and balloons, raising both arms beneath a striped party hat and falling confetti. A cake with three candles stands on a small round table beside two wrapped gifts. The coloring sheet balances large balloon and body shapes with narrow ribbons, candle stripes, and curved frosting edges.

pages.title: Roblox Noob, Bacon Hair, and Guest Standing Beneath the Roblox Logo Coloring Page
pages.description: Roblox Noob, Bacon Hair, and Guest stand together beneath the Roblox logo in this printable coloring page, smiling against a background of blocky platforms and trees. Noob occupies the center, Bacon Hair wears an open jacket, and Guest has an R cap and matching shirt emblem. This coloring sheet combines wide clothing panels with layered hair and outlined letters.

pages.title: Roblox Creator Stacking Building Blocks in a Game World Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Roblox creator stacking building blocks in a game world, holding a large rectangular piece above two blocks while wearing a hoodie. Spiky hair and blocky hands frame the growing stack, with floating platforms and cube-shaped treetops behind the avatar. Broad geometric faces and a few narrow clothing details define this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Roblox Players Climbing an Obstacle Tower Coloring Page
pages.description: Three Roblox players climb an obstacle tower above the clouds in this printable coloring page, crossing staggered platforms beside a tall frame with cross-braced supports. A hoodie, long ponytail, and backward cap distinguish the three smiling avatars at different heights. The coloring sheet offers broad platform faces and clothing sections, with smaller hair strands and a square shirt emblem.

pages.title: Roblox Brookhaven Avatar Driving a Sports Car Through Town Coloring Page
pages.description: A Roblox Brookhaven avatar drives a sports car through town in this printable coloring page, smiling behind the wheel of an open-top car with angular headlights. The wide hood, rear spoiler, and detailed wheels fill the foreground, while storefronts and geometric trees line the street. This coloring sheet includes large car panels alongside smaller wheel spokes and window frames.

pages.title: Roblox Bloxburg Builder Constructing a House Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Roblox Bloxburg builder constructing a house, raising a hammer beside a workbench while wearing a hoodie and pocketed pants. A toolbox and stacked boards sit below the unfinished two-story frame, where open doorways and a staircase are visible. The coloring sheet mixes broad walls and clothing with woodgrain lines and small tool details.

pages.title: Roblox Dress to Impress Model Wearing a Ball Gown on the Runway Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Roblox Dress to Impress model wearing a ball gown on the runway, with a jeweled tiara, curled updo, and pendant necklace. The gown has a wrapped bodice, a waist bow, and cascading skirt layers. Broad fabric panels meet smaller jewel shapes and rows of runway lights across this detailed coloring sheet.

pages.title: Roblox Adopt Me Player Petting a Unicorn Outside the Nursery Coloring Page
pages.description: A Roblox Adopt Me player pets a unicorn outside the nursery in this printable coloring page, smiling beside its striped horn, flowing mane, and curled tail. The avatar wears a heart-emblem shirt and a bow on a high ponytail. This coloring sheet has broad body shapes, separate mane strands, and the nursery's arched doors beneath a bone-shaped sign.

pages.title: Roblox Adopt Me Frost Dragon Resting Beside a Snowy Village Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Roblox Adopt Me Frost Dragon resting beside a snowy village, spreading its wings above clawed feet and a curling, crystal-covered tail. Angular horns and pointed back spikes contrast with broad wing membranes and belly plates. Snow-covered cottages and fir trees surround the dragon on this coloring sheet, adding smaller windows and layered branches.

pages.title: Roblox Adopt Me Giraffe Standing Beside a Player at the Playground Coloring Page
pages.description: A Roblox Adopt Me giraffe stands beside a player at the playground in this printable coloring page, with rounded horns, large outlined spots, and a smiling face. The player wears a butterfly shirt and a bow above long wavy hair. A swing, slide, and roofed play tower add background sections around the giraffe's patterned body on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Roblox Bedwars Player Guarding a Bed on a Floating Island Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts a Roblox BedWars player guarding a bed on a floating island, holding a broad sword beneath spiky hair and a hooded outfit. A narrow block bridge connects distant islands with geometric trees, while floating platforms fill the sky. The coloring sheet emphasizes large sword, bed, and clothing shapes alongside smaller island blocks and tree branches.

pages.title: Roblox Blox Fruits Pirate Holding a Sword on a Sailing Ship Coloring Page
pages.description: A Roblox Blox Fruits pirate holds a sword aboard a sailing ship in this printable coloring page, wearing a skull-emblem hat, open coat, and tied sash. The curved blade rises beside a sail and rope-wrapped mast, with a barrel on the deck. This coloring sheet combines broad coat panels with smaller hat details, rigging, railings, and long plank outlines.

pages.title: Roblox Blox Fruits Player Holding a Dragon Fruit at the Fruit Dealer Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Roblox Blox Fruits player holding a Dragon Fruit at the Fruit Dealer, with a hoodie and spiky hair beside the stall. The fruit has a dragonlike face, curling horns, flame-shaped edges, and a looped stem. The coloring sheet contrasts those small patterned shapes with broad clothing panels, the counter, a barrel, and distant palm trees.

pages.title: Roblox Blox Fruits Kitsune Transformation Standing on an Island Coloring Page
pages.description: A Roblox Blox Fruits Kitsune transformation stands on an island in this printable coloring page, with tall pointed ears, narrow eyes, and several sweeping, flame-patterned tails. A diamond marking sits on its forehead above a thick chest ruff and clawed paws. Layered tail shapes fill much of this detailed coloring sheet, with ocean ripples, rocks, and a palm tree behind.

pages.title: Roblox Piggy Holding a Bat in a House Hallway Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Roblox Piggy holding a bat in a house hallway, with round ears, a large oval snout, and a simple sleeveless dress. The bat stretches diagonally across the figure in front of paneled doors and a staircase. Broad head and dress areas contrast with narrower floorboards and stair rails on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Roblox Piggy Clowny Holding a Mallet at the Carnival Coloring Page
pages.description: Roblox Piggy Clowny holds a mallet at the carnival in this printable coloring page, wearing a pointed pom-pom hat, ruffled collar, and costume with large buttons. Two stars decorate the mallet head above its striped handle. This coloring sheet includes circular cheek markings, puffy side hair, and broad costume panels, with tent curtains, hanging bulbs, and a flag behind Clowny.

pages.title: Roblox Doors Figure Searching Between Library Bookshelves Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Roblox DOORS Figure searching between library bookshelves, with a round tooth-ringed mouth, exposed rib shapes, long arms, and an outstretched hand. Rows of upright books line both sides of the narrow aisle above rectangular floor tiles. The coloring sheet offers repeated book-spine sections around the creature's broad limbs and smaller teeth and rib details.

pages.title: Roblox Rainbow Friends Blue Wearing a Crown Outside a Theater Coloring Page
pages.description: Roblox Rainbow Friends Blue wears a crown outside a theater in this printable coloring page, waving beneath a curved marquee with an X-marked eye and drool below his smile. Round bulbs line the canopy above double entrance doors. This coloring sheet leaves broad spaces across Blue's body, with smaller sections in the crown points, eye outlines, drool, and theater entrance trim.

pages.title: Roblox Rainbow Friends Green Searching a Room with Stacked Boxes Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Roblox Rainbow Friends Green searching a room with stacked boxes, reaching toward the top carton with long fingers beneath bulging eyes. A wide row of pointed teeth contrasts with the character's smooth limbs and broad body. This coloring sheet adds rectangular box faces, small tape strips, an empty shelving unit, and a closed door.

pages.title: Roblox Animal Hospital Secret Agent and Intern Bunny Comic Coloring Page
pages.description: Divided into two comic panels, this printable coloring page shows Intern Bunny kissing an angry Secret Agent Black Cat under floating status icons.

pages.title: Roblox Animal Hospital Secret Agent Black Cat Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page presents three panels of Secret Agent Black Cat holding a gun, looking surprised, and sticking his tongue out with dotted background patterns.

pages.title: Roblox Animal Hospital Secret Agent and Intern Bunny Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page displays two cute scenes of Secret Agent Black Cat hugging and lifting Intern Bunny, accompanied by small floating hearts above them.

pages.title: Roblox Animal Hospital Intern Bunny Thinking Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Intern Bunny from Roblox Animal Hospital smiling with closed eyes while thinking about a cat face inside a cloud bubble surrounded by small hearts.

pages.title: Roblox Animal Hospital Secret Agent and Intern Bunny Making Coffee Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features the Roblox Animal Hospital characters Secret Agent Black Cat and Intern Bunny preparing coffee together at a counter with floating hearts.

pages.title: Roblox Dandys World Scraps Cute Bow Printable Coloring Page
pages.description: A playful close-up captures Scraps from Roblox Dandys World giving a cheerful wink with a oversized bow tucked behind her pointy ear. Framed by wavy outlines and floating heart doodles, she proudly displays her sharp clawed paws and classic bell collar. This lively character coloring page offers crisp details that look fantastic when filled in with fine-liners or gel pens.

pages.title: Roblox Dandys World Scraps Printable Coloring Page
pages.description: Cute Scraps from Roblox Dandys World stands in a detailed outfit with a large chest ribbon, bell collar, cape, and lace-up boots. Her design features big sparkling eyes, striped cat whiskers, and a long tail holding a bell. Dotted heart patterns float in the background of this clean character coloring page, perfect for coloring with gel pens or fine-liners.

pages.title: Roblox Dandy World Scraps Printable Coloring Page
pages.description: Cute Scraps from Roblox Dandys World smiles happily while showing a big paw glove with claws. This feline character features large expressive eyes, a collar with a bell, a short pleated skirt, and fluffy cuff sleeves. Clean black outlines make this character coloring page simple to fill in using alcohol markers, colored pencils, or gel pens.

pages.title: Roblox Animal Hospital Bunny Printable Coloring Page
pages.description: An energetic Roblox Animal Hospital bunny character captured mid-air features long floppy ears, a hoodie, loose pants, and a fluffy tail while pointing forward. Large stars with grid and halftone patterns accent the background. Clean line art makes this action-packed coloring page great for customizing with alcohol markers or colored pencils.
